instruction: The properties panel on the right has been closed. Please restore it so I can edit slide properties.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=12, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task asks to restore the right properties panel in LibreOffice Impress. Config modified to close properties panel (down presses=12 instead of 11). Custom metric checks for Properties panel/deck in accessibility tree. Similar difficulty to original task.
